title: WPSS/67/2018 of Pan Singh Bangari Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition (S/S) No. 67 of 2018
Pan Singh Bangari Ö..Petitioner
Versus
State of Uttarakhand and others Ö.Respondents
Mr. Subhash Upadhyaya, Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. M.C. Tiwari, Deputy Advocate General for the State of Uttarakhand/
respondents.
Dated: 09.01.2018
Honíble V.K. Bist, J.

Petitioner has approached this Court seeking the
following reliefs:
ìA- Issue a writ, order or direction in the
nature of mandamus commanding the
respondents to consider the case of the
petitioner for promotion on the post of
Administrative Officer, Senior
Administrative Officer and Chief
Administrative Officer under the quota
prescribed for the persons with
disability as per Right of Persons with
Disability Act-2016.
B- Issue a writ, order or direction in the
nature of mandamus commanding the
respondents to consider the
representation of the petitioner for
promotion as Administrative Officer,
Senior Administrative Officer and Chief
Administrative Officer.î
 2. During the course of argument, learned
counsel for the petitioner submitted that the present
petition may be decided by directing respondent no. 2
to take a decision on the representation of the
petitioner, which has also been recommended by the
Chief Veterinary Officer, Almora. This prayer of the
petitioner has not been opposed by the learned Deputy
Advocate General appearing for the State. He
submitted that, in case, such direction is issued; the

2
representation of the petitioner shall be decided in
accordance with law.
3. Considering the above submission and
considering the statement of the learned counsel for
the parties, the writ petition is disposed of with a
direction to the respondent no. 2 to take a decision on
the representation of the petitioner, which has also
been recommended by the Chief Veterinary Officer,
Almora in accordance with law and as per the Right of
Persons with Disability Act, 2016, within a period of
three weeks from the date of production of certified
copy of this judgment.
 (V.K. Bist, J.)
09.01.2018
Navin
